让网络为每个人服务

We develop open standards so that the web works for everyone, everywhere, on every device people use to reach it.

Our community of members, staff and the public works together in the open to agree the technologies the web is built on.

Specifications are drafted in public, reviewed widely and published only when they have been implemented and tested.
